planned_preservation: Six legacy skin keys/palettes/fonts remain unchanged; Studio remains opt-in seventh option.
Three real manual USD rules and14 local synthetic requests replace prototype sample names and figures.
Keep price amount formatter, pagination and current update/reload/delete actions; input_mode remains in full-row tooltip and unchanged edit form.
Move the existing health and import notices after primary settings cards, preserving their text/actions; warning card and in-card attention/error states remain.
Legacy Mono follows existing font/palette contract; its differences from the Studio-font Figma example are explicit.
known_scope_limits: This first review does not finalize a frame. Native glyph AA/shadow differences and retained controls may affect exact geometry.
1440x901/1100x701 are original native captures of1440x900/1100x700 logical windows; no image processing.
No screenshots of real credentials or production profiles.
Current macOS arm64 execution and Intel compiler gate do not prove Windows/Intel hardware, full accessibility/IME or long-run performance.
consolidated_layout_corrections: Six original22px swatches shifted2px right and1px down after exact native opaque boxes were independently compared with reference; asset bytes remain original.
Studio protocol dropdown has44px gap per reference; original native positioner still clamps to viewport at1100x700. Legacy and other menu offsets remain6px.
Retention choices share available row width; new price rule uses native Button.icon before label.
New Studio colors reuse semantic theme constants; six legacy palettes/keys/default remain unchanged.
